- Initial release of AI-powered plant nutrient deficiency diagnosis via leaf image analysis
- Supports recognition of key leaf symptoms (color changes, interveinal chlorosis, marginal scorch, deformation) to identify likely nutrient deficiencies (N, P, K, Fe, Mg, Zn, Ca, B, Mn, Cu, S) 
- Provides confidence score and fertilization direction (without dosage advice) for precision fertilization
- Includes automated open-id retrieval flow for user/result binding and strict cloud-based report history query
- Supports jpg/png image and mp4/avi/mov video input up to 10MB; output includes structured diagnosis report
- Bilingual documentation and symptom tables for both English and Chinese applications
